card.name: Linking words before pre-existing conditions
card.fires_on: The small word "of" after "worsening", or "underlying" after "individuals with", right before a term like preexisting hypertension or liver disease in warning text.

modes.label: Worsening of preexisting
modes.description: The word "of" after "worsening" just before "preexisting hypertension" in NSAID blood pressure warnings.
modes.example: can lead to new onset of hypertension or worsening<< of>> preexisting hypertension, either of which may

modes.label: Underlying disease
modes.description: The word "underlying" after "individuals with" before a disease name such as liver disease.
modes.example: The risk of acute liver failure is higher in individuals with<< underlying>> liver disease and in individuals who ingest alcohol

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like already, vulnerable and weakened, which describe a condition present beforehand.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a pre-existing or underlying condition is named in a warning.
